news.title: Nigeria vs Mexico: Flamingos Eye Quarter-Final Ticket as 2014 World Cup History Offers Hope — Kick-Off Time, H2H, Where to Watch and Prediction
news.lede: Nigeria’s Flamingos face a defining test of their 2026 FIFA U-17 Women’s World Cup campaign on Thursday, October 29, when they confront Mexico in a Round of 16 showdown in Morocco, with a quarter-final place at stake, Sports247.ng reports. news.title: World Cup winner heading to SA for Kaizer Chiefs vs Orlando Pirates clash
news.lede: PAY ATTENTION: Mark Briefly News as a preferred source, and our content will appear higher in your Google feed! Football icon Thierry Henry will be present at FNB Stadium this Saturday for the Soweto Derby between Kaizer Chiefs and Orlando Pirates, bringing international star power to one of South African football's most celebrated fixtures. Sports betting and gaming brand Betway confirmed on Thursday that it had arranged Henry's trip to South Africa. The former striker will watch Chiefs and Pirates compete for local bragging rights and will present the prize to the winner of Betway's S'bonise & Win campaign.

news.title: FIFA’s Reported $5 Billion World Cup Windfall Raises Question of Who the Game Is For
news.lede: Home » FIFA’s Reported $5 Billion World Cup Windfall Raises Question of Who the Game Is For. FIFA reportedly generated approximately $5 billion from ticket sales and hospitality at the 2026 World Cup, an extraordinary financial windfall following a tournament in which the organization’s aggressive pricing strategy sparked widespread anger from supporters, regulatory scrutiny and even reported opposition from within its own ranks. The figure, reported Thursday by The Times, represents more than five times the $929 million generated from tickets and hospitality at the 2022 World Cup in Qatar. It also significantly exceeds FIFA’s own financial projections for the tournament.

news.title: FIFA U-15 World Cup & Festival 2026: Three Special Awards Celebrate Team Spirit and Unity
news.lede: BAKU, Azerbaijan: The FIFA U-15 World Cup & Festival 2026 is introducing a distinctive approach to recognising young footballers, placing collective character, team identity and positive energy at the heart of its Special Awards programme. Hosted in Baku, Azerbaijan, the inaugural event brings together 189 participating teams, with 78 FIFA Member Associations making their FIFA World Cup debut. Beyond competition on the pitch, the festival aims to encourage friendship, cultural exchange and a shared passion for football among young players from across the world. Unlike traditional football tournaments that often emphasise individual achievements, the Special Awards focus exclusively on teams.

news.title: Greece U15s Rout Australia 7-2, Reach World Cup Semi-Finals
news.lede: BAKU, October 2026 — The Greece U15 team thrashed Australia 7-2 at the FIFA U-15 World Cup and Festival in Azerbaijan. The young Greeks have since reached the semi-finals. Coach Stelios Bikas picked the whole squad from the Greek football federation’s youth development scheme, known as Anagennisi. His players come from clubs such as Olympiacos, Panathinaikos, PAOK and AEK.

news.title: Spain Ambassador visits Ghana’s amputee football team ahead of 2026 World Cup
news.lede: The Spanish Ambassador to Ghana, His Excellency Ángel Lossada Torres-Quevedo, has visited Ghana’s national amputee football team, the Black Challenge, ahead of the 2026 Amputee Football World Cup in Mexico. The ambassador met with all 15 players and members of the technical team at the Mendiata Hotel in Accra, where he offered words of encouragement ahead of the team’s departure for the tournament. Addressing the players, Lossada Torres-Quevedo expressed his support for Ghana, while emphasising the importance of promoting the rights of persons with disabilities through sport. If, at the end of the World Cup, I am in the camp of the Spanish side, if there is a final like that, but I will be on your side in this process,” he said.
